youtube.title: Cleopatra lived closer to the iPhone than to the pyramids 📱 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Cleopatra lived closer in time to the iPhone than to the building of the Great Pyramid. 📱

Comment the reply YOU would've sent Caesar 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: the Great Pyramid of Giza was finished around 2560 BC, about 2,500 years before Cleopatra was born (69 BC). The first iPhone came out in 2007, about 2,000 years after her death. And she wasn't ethnically Egyptian: her Ptolemaic dynasty was Macedonian Greek and had ruled Egypt since 305 BC.
